items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember ever seeing his father then, Le Monde? [INTERVIEWEE] No, but I saw some uncles of his

ctx.x: It's funny how we look, we look more alike than my sister now I'm so surprised, yeah, when I saw you Yes, indeed, that's right His brother looks like my mother, you know He looks like my mother and so do I Yes Mm-hmm Because my mother had large eyes and my sister had small eyes
Do you remember ever seeing his father then, Le Monde?
No, but I saw some uncles of his
